Per-gene ancestry weights for the Cauchy combination (Step 3 helper)

Source: R/ancestry_smmat.R
dot-compute_gene_weights.Rd

Generalises the retired src/step3_weight_finding.R script's median per-gene ancestry count logic to K populations (that functionality now lives here, fed by ancestry_counts/ variant_info from Step 1): for each gene in gene_group_file, takes the median (across the gene's variants) of the per-variant pure- ancestry sample counts in ancestry_counts.

.compute_gene_weights(
  ancestry_counts,
  variant_info,
  gene_group_file,
  pop_names
)

Arguments

ancestry_counts

Numeric matrix (variants x populations), as returned by ancestry_split.

variant_info

data.frame with columns chrom/pos, row-aligned to ancestry_counts, as returned by ancestry_split.

gene_group_file

Path to the gene_group file (no header; columns gene, chr, pos, ref, alt, weight) – the same file passed to GMMAT::SMMAT().

pop_names

Character vector of population names to produce weight columns for (typically names(gds_paths) from ancestry_smmat).

Value

Numeric matrix (genes x pop_names), or NULL if none of pop_names match colnames(ancestry_counts).
